answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 62623 Country: India Title: INVESTMENT Question: (1) I would like to know if I have Rs 1 lakh and wanted to give to my friend who is into business and get Rs 5000 every month as profit fixed without any share in losses as long as he has my investment. Is this halal? (2) If he pays me variable like one time Rs. 5000 another month 6,000 is this halal? Please suggest your opinion on this with valid points. Answer ID: 62623 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 144/156/=02/1437) It is not lawful to take profit each month without investing ones money as partnership or muzarabah. Likewise if he gives money without fixing it then it shall also not be lawful to take it. If you want to earn profit then it shall be necessary to invest your money as partnership or muzarabah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
